notes.title: The first teaser of A Cairn Tale revealed during the AG French Direct
notes.content:
Hi dear pebbles

We are Rob & Louis, co-founders of Team Pebbles and developers on the project,

First of all, a big thank you for all the people who followed us these last days following our teaser at the [url=https://www.actugaming.net/ag-french-direct/]AG French Direct[/url].
It's a first stone for a project that still has a long way to go: it's our first game, imagined during our studies with our artistic directors, Florine and Mathieu.

A Cairn Tale aims to recreate the feelings of wonder, of surpassing oneself that you can feel during a hike in the mountains and to tell a sensitive tale about the traumas and the heritage that we leave behind.

[previewyoutube=2pmysdtypD4;full][/previewyoutube]

The next step is to find partners and then create a demo that you can play. We can't give you a date for the demo yet (and even less for the release of the game), but we'll keep you updated on our progress here and on our social networks: [url=https://twitter.com/a_cairn_tale]Twitter [/url]& [url=https://www.instagram.com/a_cairn_tale/]Instagram[/url].

So stay tuned and take care,
Rob & Louis
